Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 11 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Hema - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Naira - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits
4. Vimla - 63 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Hema and Naira stand near him.]

Aditya: "Today feels like a good day."

[Aditya walks across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "Hmm, I see."

[Aditya jumps with joy.]

Aditya: "Exactly right."

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya (gently): "Exactly right."

[Aditya climbs the stairs to the terrace.]

Aditya: "Okay, Naira."

[Aditya hides behind the tree.]

Aditya: "This is amazing!"

[Aditya searches for his lost ball.]

Hema: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya peeks out from behind the door.]

Aditya (surprised): "Mom, look at this."

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Aditya stands in the park. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Aditya throws the ball to Mother.]

Aditya: "That was fun!"

[Aditya catches the ball.]

Aditya (surprised): "One more time!"

[Aditya kicks the football hard.]

Hema (surprised): "That's great!"

[Aditya plays cricket in the park.]

Aditya (happily): "Oh wow!"

[Aditya swings on the swing.]

Hema (laughing): "I really enjoyed today."
